blurb: CipherX offers immersive escape rooms with themed sets, atmospheric lighting, original puzzles, and live Game Masters who provide hints. They also provide VR experiences, axe throwing, rage rooms, golf simulators, and slime parties. Two locations serve Coquitlam and Delta with multiple activities for individuals, groups, and corporate events.
extraNote: Arrive 10-15 minutes early; late arrivals reduce session time · Rescheduling free with 48+ hours notice; refunds per booking terms · No deposit held on card until arrival
